title: The Impact of Subscription Programs on Customer Purchases
design_notes: Customer-month panel (April 2015 to March 2017) from an Asian personal-care retailer. DD: Y_it = tau*Member_it + customer FE + month FE (Eq. 1; Eq. 2 adds log price and log baseline budget plus gift cards). Main analysis uses a single cohort of 721 members who joined in April 2016 (month of adoption dropped), embedded in a generalized random forest that matches each member to weighted nonmembers (671 members, 11,745 nonmembers after common-support trimming). Robustness uses late adopters (Aug-Nov 2016 joiners) as controls and other single cohorts separately; none is a pooled staggered TWFE.
eligible_reason: Single adoption month (April 2016) in the main analysis; matching-based DiD (GRF) with extra time-varying controls in Eq. 2; cohort robustness is cohort-by-cohort, not staggered.
screener_notes: Firm transaction data under a nondisclosure agreement; the article says some detailed results are available from the authors on request. Ineligible on design.
screened_from: article text only (no package_dir or regressions file in batch_t2_004)
